name: skill2_est__sonnet__p02

diagnostics.msg: a fixed colour (rgb()/rgb8()/hsv2rgb()/palette on fixed args) must be returned directly from shade()

base_estimate: a loop runs 8 times per LED (~69,224 cycles): precompute per-item data in update(), skip items far from the LED early, or cut the count (line 89) — saves up to ~34,612 cycles/LED (~108.2 ms at 500 LEDs)

float hsv2rgb() ×8 per LED (~1,311 cycles each): pass three args of the same fixed type (hsv2rgb(h, fixed(0.9), fixed(1.0))) for the integer path and return it from shade(), or precompute a colour table (line 103) — saves up to ~7,536 cycles/LED (~23.6 ms at 500 LEDs)
26 int/fixed↔float conversions per LED (~318 cycles each): keep a value in one type end to end (all-fixed maths, fixed() context reads) — saves up to ~4,961 cycles/LED (~15.5 ms at 500 LEDs)
